sloka: यद्वा विशसि लोकांस्त्रीन् पक्षिभूतो मनोजवः ।मम चक्षुष्पथं प्राप्य न जीवन् प्रतियास्यसि ।। ६.४१.७० ।।।।
transliteration: yadvā viśasi lokāṁstrīn pakṣibhūto manojavaḥ ।mama cakṣuṣpathaṁ prāpya na jīvan pratiyāsyasi ।। 6.41.70 ।।।।

translations.english: "One who is not aware of himself, an unrighteous sinner ruling with foolish mates cannot enjoy the kingdom even for a moment."
